title: 86% of Japan's Game Developers Use AI
paragraphs: Most video game developers in Japan now use generative AI in their work, according to a new survey. Generative AI is a type of AI that can create new content, such as images, text and music.

The survey was carried out by the Computer Entertainment Supplier's Association (CESA), an organization that represents Japan's video game industry. The results were released on September 17, 2026, during the Tokyo Game Show, one of the world's biggest video game events. The survey took place online between May and August 2026, and 1,349 people working in game development answered it. The results were released as a preview of CESA's full 2026 report on the game industry.
The survey found that 85.8% of the developers use generative AI. About 63% said they use it regularly in their work, and another 22.8% said they use it sometimes.

Many news reports said this was a big jump from 51% a year earlier. However, CESA said that 2026 was the first time it had asked this question in this way, so the two numbers may not be directly comparable.

CESA also asked game companies what they expected from AI. The most common answer was that AI would help people work more efficiently and get more done. However, only 48 of the 220 companies answered this question. According to reports, many developers also see problems with AI, such as questions about copyright.
The survey did not say exactly what developers use AI for. For example, it is not clear whether they mainly use it to create art, write text or write computer code.
Interestingly, game developers in other parts of the world seem to feel differently. Another industry survey suggested that many developers in North America are still doubtful about using AI.
